content: As of 2026-08-13, UEFA EURO 2028 is still pre-draw: the official draw is scheduled for 2026-12-06 in Belfast, qualifying groups start in 2027-03 and end in 2027-11, and the qualification system uses twelve groups of four or five with 12 winners and 8 best runners-up advancing directly. Official euro2028/fixtures-results returns 404 and euro2028/standings redirects to /errors/, so Phase 13 should register a pre_draw edition with explicit source/output slots rather than fabricate groups or standings.
